newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA KEEPS SRI LANKA ON TARGET.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA KEEPS SRI LANKA ON TARGET.

text.p: Opener Sanath Jayasuriya completed his ninth test half century as Sri Lanka made a solid reply to India's 537 for eight on the third day of the first test on Monday.
Jayasuriya reached 72 not out and Roshan Mahanama an unbeaten 36 in a lunch total of 136 for one.
Resuming at 39 for one, both batsmen showed little discomfort as India's mixed pace and spin on the slow, docile pitch.
Jayasuriya reached his 50 with a square drive off off-spinner Rajesh Chauhan for his ninth four. The left-hander had faced 72 balls in a stay of 92 minutes.
Mahanama, batting in a new number three position and needing a big score behind him, helped Jayasuriya add 97 for the second wicket.
It was a record second wicket partnership for Sri Lanka against India, beating the previous best of 95 between Amal Silva and Ranjan Madugalle in Colombo in 1985-86.
